sections.description: What the program may use. Everything is allowed by default.

settings.description: Memory from the system heap while the program runs: new, malloc, a standard container that grows, the frame of a task. LVGL's own fixed pool is not the system heap.
Threads, and the locks between them.
Files and the standard streams: fopen, stdin, stdout.
Floating-point arithmetic while the program runs. The compiler still uses it to make fonts, pictures and tokens.

sections.description: The library's own strictness. Everything is strict by default.

settings.description: Plain values such as 8 * lv::px in styles, beside design tokens.
A state, a computed value or a row field of a plain integer, beside a quantity, an lv::counter or a named type.

The forms of a token value from before the Design Tokens Format 2025.10: "#3366ff" for a color, "8px" or a bare number for a dimension, "200ms" for a duration. Only for the time a project's files convert: tools/dtcg_fix.py rewrites a token file.
The largest picture that the compiler decodes. Decoding costs compile time: about a second for 48 x 48, many for a whole screen.
